name: Sun Cleric: Gleaming Vigil stays applied above 80% health (#7829)
contract: Gleaming Vigil (704585) reduces Physical damage taken by 6%, plus 6% more while above 80% health, through helper 707769.

The helper lasts 1500 ms in the DBC (SpellDuration 65). AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp dummies 704585's native 500 ms periodic trigger, so AscensionSunCleric.cpp's Refresh owns applying and removing it from the 80%/75% health gate every 500 ms.
At stable 95% health the helper must stay applied without being cast again. An expiring helper recreated by the next refresh is the reported buff that fades and comes back every 2 seconds.
A drop to 70% removes it; climbing back to 85% grants it once and it then stays without further casts.
Unlearning the talent removes the helper again. Regeneration is disabled so the health condition stays independent of time.

Gleaming Vigil's helper is still applied after 20 seconds

Climbing back above 80% grants it again
The re-granted helper stays without further casts
It is still applied at the end of the window
